agendaBlocks.title: Morning Kick-off & Deep Dives
agendaBlocks.description: Start your day with registration, followed by an inspiring Welcome Keynote. Then, dive into parallel tracks of in-depth Technical Sessions covering the latest in Web, Mobile, AI, and Cloud technologies led by industry experts.

agendaBlocks.title: Networking Lunch
agendaBlocks.description: Recharge and connect with fellow attendees, speakers, and sponsors over a delicious complimentary lunch. Share insights and make new connections in a relaxed atmosphere.

agendaBlocks.title: Afternoon Workshops & Talks
agendaBlocks.description: Engage in practical, hands-on Workshops, catch quick and impactful Lightning Talks on innovative projects, and explore our Community Showcase featuring local tech talent and initiatives.

agendaBlocks.title: DevFest After Party!
agendaBlocks.description: Unwind and celebrate a day of learning and collaboration! Join us for an evening of music, refreshments, games, and more networking opportunities. Don't miss out on the fun!
